unrestricted.description: A one-element tuple with no additionalItems:false and no maxItems. Position 0 must be a string, but positions 1+ are unconstrained, so this must NOT collapse to []string.

notAdditional.description: additionalItems is a real `not` constraint, not the false schema: anything non-integer may follow position 0. Must NOT collapse to []string.

typedAdditional.description: additionalItems permits further strings, so the array is still open.
